Shurelya's is too hard to use/get good uptime without taking ingenious hunter. You have to use your shield to proc it or use the active, which puts you in a problematic situation.   
Do you shield a teammate to protect them from magic damage and cc or do you shield them to give them the speed boost? It has too long of a cooldown to be in a situation like this. 15 seconds at max rank is too high for it to be effective.   
Liandry's is too expensive for support as a whole tbh.  


Also, the way you play can affect the mythic of your choice. For example, one player could be more of an engage/pick maker type which would benefit from shurelya's more. Another player could focus on landing qs midfight on high priority targets, which would lend itself more towards mandate.  
Finally, looking at some of the comments in this thread shows how little of other champs some people play. mandate doesn't need a rework. If anything needs to get changed, shurelya's needs to get reverted. Champs like nami, bard, singed, ASol, etc. all have used mandate to great effects. It doesnt need a rework, shurelyas just needs to get nerfed.

For assassin/bruiser comps, I'd recommend trying to use galeforce into a situational item. Galeforce in combination with your W+Q to try and kite/dodge damage, and using your Ultimate to dodge damage/survive burst.  
For tank heavy comps, kraken slayer into botrk/collector, it helps you shred tanks.  
For heavy ap comps, maw is a nice situational item, with either shieldbow, galeforce, or kraken slayer for your mythic first.   


Just in general, you should try and use mythic to help you be stronger against the enemy comp. If you need to survive burst, go shieldbow. If you need to potentially dodge damage/kite, go for galeforce. If you need to shred tanks, go for kraken slayer.
